messages:
olivia: Quick thread — drafting the run-sheet for the May webinar. need sign-off on speaker order, localization + a demo failover plan.
ken: +1 on failover. can we prerecord a 3-min demo clip as a fallback?
olivia: yes, plan A = live demo, plan B = prerecorded clip. tam can you own the clip export?
tam: yep. will export MP4 1080p, subtracks for EN/ES/FR. ETA Tue.
sunil: for localization: we should add live captions (EN) and pre-baked subtitles for ES/FR/DE. ops-bot can we enable captions via stream config?
ops-bot: reminder queued: enable captions flag on webinar instance. scheduled check 24h before event. :robot_face:
lisa: speaker order suggestion: 1) intro (olivia) 2) benchmarks (ken) 3) demo (tam) 4) panel (sunil + lisa + ken) 5) q&a. keep total to 45m.
ken: fine. for the benchmarks segment i'd like a 7-min narrative: cost/latency tradeoffs -> one slide per tradeoff -> 2 quick benchmark screenshots.
olivia: OK. mic check windows: EU friendly time, start 9:30 PT -> 5:30 CET. that gives APAC awkwardness but we'll record.
tam: rehearsal schedule proposal: dry run (tech only) 48h before, full run-through 24h before, recorded backup test 4h before.
sunil: routing for inbound leads during the webinar: high intent (demo requests, POC asks) -> sales queue 'webinar-high', marketing ops parses chat and tags leads with 'webinar-2026'. low intent (content downloads) -> nurture. can we add a hidden form for demo requests?
lisa: yes, add CTA button "Request demo" (opens hidden form). forms team will push to SFDC with source=webinar-2026.
ken: also add an automated Slack alert to #sales-inbound when a high-intent form is submitted. include email, company, and intent tag.
ops-bot: automation configured: SFDC push + slack alert. will run in dry mode during rehearsal.
olivia: run-sheet snippet (use as canonical flow for rehearsals):
```
00:00 — 00:05 intro (olivia) 
00:05 — 00:12 benchmarks (ken)
00:12 — 00:25 demo (tam)  live -> fallback clip at 00:20 if fails
00:25 — 00:37 panel (3 ppl)
00:37 — 00:45 q&a + CTA + close
```
ken: add 60s buffer for segues between demo and panel. we should also pin the prerecorded clip in the producer console.
tam: noted. exporting two clip flavors: full screen + PiP (speaker inset) so ops can swap fast.
sunil: rehearsal checklist quick: captions ON, backup clip loaded, hidden form tested, SFDC mapping verified, speaker mics checked.
lisa: I'll run the checklist during the 24h full run. tagging folks for times: @ken @tam @sunil please confirm availability for 24h run (Thu 9:00 PT).
ken: confirmed.
tam: confirmed.
sunil: confirmed.
olivia: perfect. two final asks: (1) marketing copy for landing page — need a 2-sentence hook + 3 bullets by EOD Wed, (2) one-slide cheat sheet for panelists with 3 talking points each.
lisa: will own copy and slide. sending draft by EOD Wed.
ops-bot: rehearsal reminders set: 48h, 24h, 4h, 10m.
olivia: thanks all — will upload final run-sheet to the shared drive and ping when live. :sparkles:
